SELECT id,post_id AS postId,version_no AS versionNo,post_type AS postType, summary,snapshot_json AS snapshotJson,created_at AS createdAt FROM post_version WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND version_no=#{versionNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_version(id,post_id,version_no,post_type,summary,snapshot_json,created_by) VALUES(#{version.id},#{version.postId},#{version.versionNo},#{version.postType}, #{version.summary},#{version.snapshotJson},#{version.createdBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id FROM post_tag WHERE post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY tag_id

SELECT id,post_id,usage_type,media_type,url,poster_url,alt_text,width,height, sort_order,created_at,updated_at,deleted,deleted_at FROM post_media WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET slug=#{post.slug},title=#{post.title},summary=#{post.summary},content=#{post.content}, content_format=#{post.contentFormat},category_id=#{post.categoryId}, reading_time_minutes=#{post.readingTimeMinutes},status=#{post.status}, published_at=#{post.publishedAt},updated_by=#{ownerId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{post.id} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE deleted=1 AND (#{type}='ALL' OR type=#{type})

SELECT p.id,p.type,p.slug,p.title,p.summary,p.content,p.content_format AS contentFormat, p.created_by AS authorUserId,pf.display_name AS authorName,pf.avatar_url AS authorAvatar, c.id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName,c.slug AS categorySlug, c.description AS categoryDescription,c.deleted AS categoryDeleted, p.created_at AS createdAt,p.updated_at AS updatedAt,p.published_at AS publishedAt, p.reading_time_minutes AS readingTime,p.status,p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount,p.version FROM post p INNER JOIN profile pf ON pf.user_id=p.created_by LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.deleted=1 AND (#{type}='ALL' OR p.type=#{type}) ORDER BY p.deleted_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET deleted=0,deleted_at=NULL,deleted_by=NULL,status='DRAFT',published_at=NULL, updated_by=#{ownerId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=1 AND version=#{version}
UPDATE post SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_by=#{ownerId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
UPDATE post SET slug=#{slug},updated_by=#{ownerId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND type='TECH' AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
